meta.title: Nuelments Shopify Ecommerce — Case Study | Teknoppy
meta.description: How Teknoppy built nuelments.com on Shopify for an Indian D2C hair care brand, with certification trust badges, shoppable video, and combo bundling.

sections.h1Rest: Built for a D2C Hair Care Brand

paragraphs.text: Nuelments is an Indian D2C hair care brand selling onion and biotin shampoo, conditioner, hair serum, biotin gummies, hair masks, and co-wash formulas, positioned around a mix of natural ingredients and dermatologically tested formulation. Teknoppy's goal was to build a Shopify store that could turn product claims into visible trust, give customers an easy path to higher-value combo purchases, and let video content double as a shopping surface rather than just marketing.

items.title: No structured combo offering
items.text: Complementary products (shampoo + conditioner, etc.) likely weren't packaged into a dedicated bundle collection, missing an easy path to a higher-value purchase.

items.title: No visible trust certifications
items.text: Claims like cruelty-free, paraben-free, and dermatologically tested weren't surfaced as visual proof, leaving a new-to-market brand to rely on product copy alone for credibility.

items.title: No shoppable video experience
items.text: Product videos and demos likely existed separately from the storefront, with no direct path from watching to buying.

items.title: No visual efficacy proof
items.text: Without before/after imagery, claims about scalp and hair improvement had no visual evidence backing them up on the page.

items.title: A dedicated Combo Offers collection (directly answers Problem 1)
items.text: Complementary products are bundled into a Combos collection, giving customers an easy, discounted path to a higher-value cart.

items.title: Six certification badges built into the storefront (directly answers Problem 2)
items.text: Non-Comedogenic, Made in India, Cruelty Free, FDA Approved, Paraben Free, Sulphate Free, and Dermatologically Tested badges are surfaced prominently, turning claims into visible trust signals.

items.title: A "Shop the Look Instantly" shoppable video section (directly answers Problem 3)
items.text: Customers can discover and buy products directly from video content, rather than video sitting disconnected from the storefront.

items.title: Before/after visual proof (directly answers Problem 4)
items.text: A dedicated before/after banner gives visual evidence for scalp and hair improvement claims, reinforcing product efficacy at a glance.

items.title: Wishlist and first-purchase discount built in
items.text: A wishlist feature and a "FIRST05" first-purchase discount code support repeat consideration and lower the barrier for first-time buyers.

items.q: What was the main goal of the Nuelments Shopify project?
items.a: To build a store that turns hair care product claims into visible trust — through certification badges, shoppable video, and before/after proof — while making combo purchases easy.
Onion and biotin shampoo and conditioner, hair serum, biotin gummies, an anti-dandruff hair mask, and a hard-water co-wash, sold individually and as combo offers.

items.q: Did the project affect Nuelments' existing rankings?
items.a: The project was scoped to avoid keyword cannibalization across the site's product and collection pages — no overlapping targets were introduced.
